text:
I am trembling

the bare tree is trembling and, in mirrors,

singing

and the moon is singing

laughing

without silences

the lyrical and romantic

flute and sickle in the sky

for the first time

open their cherry light and dung.


Neither mornings can complain

nor the burning torpor that, for its barrenness,

I sing no more, I sing no more

nor can I undo spring

nor deny it and drink

nor kill without meaning to

nor walk by touch

since the air is hard

and coins, madnesses

wait

for the mark of water

in distress, laughing

laughing, laughing.


Ah, if rancor, if then

I no longer want

I could no longer, it passes, never reaches

a wave wanders, the tide

loses its bearings like this

and the sun exists here only in words

But in the sky

there is room for many, so many. Sometimes

they bother each other, bite

at the lips.

translation.title: Keeping Silent
